integrity: The source six-equation model and its endemic balance relations are reconstructed from the publicly described system; new parameter comparisons use exact symbolic differentiation and independent rational residual substitution. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Mathematical equilibrium occupancy only. The exact parameter example is not calibrated to clinical data; the isolated failure class is nontransmitting; no ordering of incidence, transient infections, treatment cost, or public-health outcomes is asserted.
title: A treatment-induced endemic-caseload reversal in the SEITFR conjunctivitis model
